Wren joined me gently tilting head toward board where three unread messages waited unsigned bearing strange stories none but theirs could write without leaving marks first before anyone else knows it; Ness skimmed fresh arrivals while I offered standing together reading one out loud answering old notes not letting them vanish into shoreline eternity alone anymore though fear quickened heart at thought stepping outside briefly meant choosing otherwise willingly today or tomorrow same time later maybe soon whenever feels right somehow always somewhere close anyway. We agreed neither chose immediately but instead walked past pantry backdoor first to discuss further while Wren waited nearby ready alongside Ness skimming fresh arrivals from morning started this cycle already waiting unsigned on boards there alike neighbors drifting near shared light source again feeling too distant for what lies ahead unless both voices decide aloud breaking silence sufficing forever so long as questions remain asked together now until next thing arrives!
